name: Loading
description: Signals an indeterminate wait: a spinner, dots, a pulse, bars, a matrix or a shimmer.
propsSummary: kind: spinner | dots | pulse | bars | matrix | shimmer (default: spinner)

label.description: What is loading, read by screen readers

kind.description: How the wait is drawn: spinner where a result will appear, dots while a reply is written, pulse while something live listens or connects, bars while a stream or voice comes in, matrix while work is assembled, shimmer shows the label with the working sheen

inline.description: Size the spinner to the surrounding text (1em) so it sits inside a line

fill.description: Fill the parent and centre the spinner in it

delay.description: Milliseconds of quiet before the spinner shows; 0 when the caller already waited

when: Waiting on an async action where the result will appear
The first paint of an app (Loading.Screen)
A short wait inside a line of text (inline)
An assistant writing a reply (dots), a live session listening (pulse), audio or a stream arriving (bars), work being assembled such as a build or a generated screen (matrix)
The step an agent is on, in words: "Searching the codebase…" (shimmer)
whenNot: You know the percentage: use Progress
You know the shape of the result: use Skeleton
An assistant working on a reply: use ThinkingIndicator
guidelines: One size, 16px or the line's own (inline); every kind takes the ink of whatever it sits in
Pick the kind by what is happening, not for variety: spinner by default, the others where they say more
Nothing shows for the first second; work that finishes sooner shows nothing
Dim the content in place rather than covering it
Name the wait in the label: "Loading findings", not "Loading"
accessibility: role="status" with the label as its name and as hidden text once the spinner shows
The spinner keeps turning under reduced motion: it is progress, not decoration
Under reduced motion the dots, pulse and bars stop moving and only fade in turn; the matrix only ever fades, so it runs as it is; the shimmer holds still in ink 3

examples.name: Default
examples.description: A spinner where the result will appear, after a second of quiet.

examples.name: Kinds
examples.description: Six ways to draw a wait, each for a different kind of work.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="xl" align="center" wrap>
  <Loading delay={0} label="Loading findings" />
  <Loading kind="dots" delay={0} label="Writing a reply" />
  <Loading kind="pulse" delay={0} label="Listening" />
  <Loading kind="bars" delay={0} label="Receiving audio" />
  <Loading kind="matrix" delay={0} label="Building the preview" />
  <Loading kind="shimmer" delay={0} label="Thinking…" />
</Stack>

examples.name: Agent at work
examples.description: The shimmer names the step; it changes as the work moves on.
examples.code: <Loading kind="shimmer" delay={0} label="Searching 214 files for raw colour values…" />

examples.name: Typing
examples.description: Dots where the reply will appear, until its first words arrive.
examples.code:
import { Message } from '@/components/Message';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack gap="md">
  <Message from="user">
    <Message.Content>Which screens still use raw colours?</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <Message from="assistant">
    <Message.Content>
      <Loading kind="dots" delay={0} label="Assistant is writing a reply" />
    </Message.Content>
  </Message>
</Stack>

examples.name: Live session
examples.description: A pulse while a session listens, bars while a voice comes in. The status names the state, so the visible words are hidden from screen readers.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<Stack gap="sm">
  <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center">
    <Loading kind="pulse" delay={0} label="Listening" />
    <Text color="secondary" aria-hidden="true">Listening</Text>
  </Stack>
  <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center">
    <Loading kind="bars" delay={0} label="Receiving audio" />
    <Text color="secondary" aria-hidden="true">Receiving audio</Text>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
